Various notable daily newspapers made endorsements of candidates in the 2016 United States presidential election, as follows.
The table below indicates which candidate each publication endorsed in the 2012 United States presidential election and includes only endorsements for the general election.

7.   **^**This was the _Union Leader_'s first endorsement of a Libertarian for president, and their first endorsement for a non-Republican in over 100 years.[39] On November 5, the _Union Leader_ published an additional editorial re-affirming their support of Johnson.

10.   **^**The _Enquirer_ had not endorsed a Democrat for president since 1916 (Woodrow Wilson).[50] On November 2, the _Enquirer_ published an additional editorial, re-affirming their endorsement.
15.   **^**_USA Today_ published an editorial urging readers not to vote for Donald Trump, marking the first time the newspaper had taken a position in a presidential election in its 34-year history.

17.   **^**This was the _Tribune_'s first endorsement of a Libertarian for president, and first for a third party since 1912 (former Republican Theodore Roosevelt).[76] Traditionally a Republican paper, it endorsed Obama in 2008 and 2012.
